tools.name: calculate_life_insurance_coverage
tools.description: Calculates an indicative life-insurance coverage amount for a resident of Spain with PuntoSeguro's published method: five years of net annual income plus outstanding debts, minus existing life cover, rounded up to the nearest 10,000 EUR. Returns the amount and its breakdown. Informational only; not individualized financial advice, premiums or savings products.

annual_net_income_eur.description: Annual net income to protect for dependants, in euros

outstanding_debts_eur.description: Outstanding debts, including mortgage balance, in euros

existing_life_cover_eur.description: Existing life-insurance cover already in force, in euros

tools.name: open_life_insurance_quote_form
tools.description: Displays PuntoSeguro's life-insurance quote form, in which the user types an exact date of birth and chooses a coverage amount; submitting it shows the quotes available through PuntoSeguro. Optionally preselects a coverage amount. Sends and stores no personal data. Residents of Spain only.

coverage_amount_eur.description: Coverage amount in euros to preselect, only if the user already stated or calculated one

tools.name: list_life_insurance_quotes
tools.description: Returns the indicative annual life-insurance protection (vida riesgo) premiums available through PuntoSeguro for a resident of Spain, given an exact date of birth and a coverage amount: insurer ids, insurer names and premiums for death, death and disability, double and triple capital, and displays the comparison interface where supported. When the date of birth or the coverage amount is missing, it returns PuntoSeguro's quote form and the list of missing details instead of quotes. Results are limited to the insurers available through PuntoSeguro and are not a whole-market comparison.

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

tools.name: get_life_insurance_quote_details
tools.description: Returns the coverage sections, included and excluded items, payment options and premium variants of one quote, identified by an insurer id from list_life_insurance_quotes for the same date of birth and coverage amount. Residents of Spain only.

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

coverage_variant.description: Coverage variant to inspect; use death when the user has not selected another variant

tools.name: start_life_insurance_application
tools.description: Returns the secure link to start an application on puntoseguro.com for one quote, identified by an insurer id from list_life_insurance_quotes, a coverage option, the date of birth and the coverage amount. The application, health questionnaire and signature are completed by the user on puntoseguro.com; this tool submits nothing and collects no personal data. The final premium is subject to the insurer's underwriting.

insurer_id.description: Insurer id returned by list_life_insurance_quotes for the same date of birth and coverage amount

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

coverage_variant.description: Coverage option the user chose; death if the user has not chosen another

tools.name: get_life_insurance_prices_by_age
tools.description: Returns annual life-insurance protection (vida riesgo) premiums available through PuntoSeguro for a resident of Spain, given an age in whole years and a coverage amount, without a date of birth: insurer ids, insurer names and premiums for death, death and disability, double capital, triple capital and death and disability plus 30,000 EUR for serious illnesses. Each premium is the highest that can apply at that age, so with the exact date of birth (list_life_insurance_quotes) the premium is the same or lower; the date of birth is also needed for the application link. Not a whole-market comparison.

age.description: Age of the person to insure, in whole years (18-70)

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

tools.name: list_health_insurance_quotes
tools.description: Returns indicative monthly private health-insurance (seguro de salud) premiums available through PuntoSeguro for residents of Spain, given the age of each person to insure and their province: insurer, product, cover type (full, outpatient or reimbursement), copay, main covers, documentation and a link to apply on puntoseguro.com, and displays the comparison interface where supported. When the ages or the province are missing, it returns PuntoSeguro's quote form and the list of missing details instead of quotes. Uses no medical information. Results are limited to the insurers available through PuntoSeguro and are not a whole-market comparison.

insured_ages.description: Age in whole years (0-99) of each person to insure, one entry per person

province.description: Spanish province where the insured people live; for the Balearic Islands choose the island option
